summary: 1927 Nez Perce-plan log cabin with cupola in Idaho County; last manned 1969, restored 1994-95, drive-up and still standing.

facts.design: Nez Perce log lookout house plan (L-3 type), modified to 15x15 ft
facts.status_note: Emergency status since 1969 per Idaho Fire Lookouts; restored 1994-95; a 2023 visit noted two broken windows.

access.note: Drive-up site on an unpaved forest road. A 2023 visit report describes graffiti carved inside the cabin. No closure notice found in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: 19.5 miles of unpaved NF-492 from Santiam Road; 4x4 recommended; not plowed in winter.

events.note: Constructed using the Nez Perce log lookout house plan. The builder changed the 16x14 blueprint to 15x15 ft and added windows.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts says 1969 was the last year manned and the site was then placed on emergency status. Firelookout.com and Dangerous Roads say it was abandoned in 1969. The year agrees across sources; the label differs. The story reports both.
NHLR gives 6,755 ft (2,059 m). Firelookout and the Idaho page give 6,800 ft. Dangerous Roads gives 6,811 ft. The story says roughly 6,800 ft.

NHLR calls it the Nez Perce Log Lookout House Plan with modified dimensions. Firelookout and the Idaho page call it an L-3 type. The story uses the NHLR wording and notes the L-3 label is from the other sources.

notes_for_editor: The only current-condition source is the Idaho Fire Lookouts post dated September 29, 2023. No 2024-2026 status found. Brief elevation (2058.9 m) matches NHLR's 6,755 ft. Brief label 'abandoned 1969' is contested, so the story reports both labels. Access is public on the sources read; no closure notice was found. No fire history and no rental listing appeared in the pages read. Budget used: 6 page reads, 2 searches.
